FN-16SG3L3-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 55
Committee: Agriculture and Forestry Sponsor: Representative Matt Simpson
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/10/2025
House Bill 55 as introduced could reduce saltwater license fee receipts to the Seafood Fund
administered by the Department of Conservation and Natural Resources by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the number of licenses foregone for each person that otherwise would
purchase the license at the following rates:
License/State AL LA FL Other
Annual $29.35 $129.20 $48.20 $63.30
7-Day Trip $12.10 $33.75 $30.20 $34.80
In addition, the bill could decrease receipts to the fund from federal matching funds by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the license obtained for each person and the applicable
federal matching rate.
